title: Strava
explanation: Connect Strava to get your flat pace and your times on climbs from your runs. ClimbSpot reads your runs and trail runs, private ones included, and never shows them to anyone else.

end.confirm: End the Strava connection? ClimbSpot erases your imported runs, your times on climbs and the flat pace from Strava.

callback.title: Connecting Strava
callback.denied: Strava was not connected: ClimbSpot was not allowed to read your runs.
callback.signedOut: Sign in to connect your Strava account.
